main_body: A brown, blocky, irregular silhouette: a large brown mass in the middle with a smaller boxy brown block on the left and a tan block at the lower right. All are flat brown fills with black outlines, and no clear object can be identified.
top_band: none. A single middle column runs from dark outline into brown fill with no lighter horizontal band. Only a 1-row tan highlight sits at the very top (rows 1-2) and small tan flecks appear elsewhere, which is not a surface.
evidence: Reading down the middle of the tall brown block, there is a black outline, then a 1-row tan fleck, then uniform brown down to the base. There is no lighter horizontal top band, no front-edge line and no eave shadow. The left block has the same flat brown fill with a few tan dashes and an outline, so it reads as a front panel. The tan block at the lower right is also a flat fill. All of it is a flat front view with no visible horizontal surface.

style.evidence: The candidate has about 2-3 tones: one brown, one tan, and a black outline. It has large flat brown areas of 5x5 pixels or more with no grain or dots. The outline is near-black and uniform, which gives the sticker look. Each tile holds only 2-4 colours, far below the reference stall and well, which carry 5-6 steps, tinted outlines and texture.
